source_title: Will always be cheering for you: Hrithik's warm birthday note for Sussanne - India Today
source_excerpt:
Hrithik Roshan shared a heartfelt birthday wish for ex-wife, fashion designer Sussanne Khan, praising her strength and warmth. The actor also called her the best mother to their sons, Ray and Ridz.
Hrithik Roshan has shared a heartfelt, albeit belated, birthday message to his former wife, fashion designer Sussanne Khan. Sharing rare photographs of Sussanne on Instagram, the actor praised her strength, warmth and role as a mother to their sons, Ray and Ridz.
The message reflects the cordial relationship Hrithik and Sussanne have maintained since their divorce in 2014 after 14 years of marriage.
Hrithik began his Instagram post by acknowledging that his wish had come late. He wrote, "This wish comes belated but from the bottom of my heart nevertheless. Happy, happy birthday, Sussanne (sic)." View this post on Instagram A post shared by Hrithik Roshan (@hrithikroshan)
A post shared by Hrithik Roshan (@hrithikroshan)
Wishing her love and happiness in the year ahead, he continued, "My wish for you is that this year brings you all the love, warmth, joy and magic that you so beautifully and freely give to the people around you (sic)."
Hrithik also praised Sussanne for the way she had handled challenges and grown as a person. "I am so proud of the life you have lived, the challenges you have faced, and the person you have grown into. Truly, Mom's spirit lives on in you (sic)," he wrote.
He went on to acknowledge her role as a mother to their sons. "You are the best mama to Ray and Ridz, and I am so thankful that they have such a positive source of light in their mother. One that never tires of seeing the brighter side of life! (sic)"
Quoting a phrase used by her father, Hrithik wrote, "You are amazing, like Dad says, ‘Amazing is what amazing does!’ You do amazing things."
He also wished for the growth of Sussanne's design venture, The Charcoal Project. "More power to you. May The Charcoal Project find its way into every city across the world that your heart dreams of conquering (sic)!" he wrote.
Hrithik ended the message by assuring Sussanne of his support: "I am and will always be here cheering for you (sic)."
Responding to his post, Sussanne commented, "Thank you so much Rye! To great Parentship to our Ray n Ridz !! N the happiest times and brightest smiles forward for all of us.. you, Saba, n me n Arslan (sic)."
Sussanne had recently responded to Hrithik's Instagram post marking five years with Saba . The post featured photographs tracing the couple's journey through moments of love, laughter and travel.
The pictures included a playful reflection selfie in which Hrithik and Saba smiled at the camera. Another showed Hrithik posing by the water as Saba sat on the grass behind him. One photograph captured them kissing by the sea at sunset.
In a candid pub selfie, Saba pulled a funny expression while Hrithik smiled beside her. Other photographs showed the couple holding hands across an outdoor restaurant table and posing inside an aircraft while wearing aviation headphones.
Responding to the post, Sussanne wrote, "Soooo sweeet. Happy anniversary." Hrithik made his relationship with Saba public in 2022 by sharing a photograph with her on social media. The two have since regularly shared pictures from their holidays.
Hrithik recently made a cameo in Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 . Before this, he was seen in Ayan Mukerji's War 2 , which also featured Jr NTR and Kiara Advani in lead roles. The sixth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe received mixed-to-negative reviews.
